Name: Item Bundler
Author: simimin
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Differing qualities of the same item often take up too much inventory space. This mod allows you to combine these items into the same inventory slot! But be careful, the slot can still hold a maximum of 999 items.

Haven't been able to fully test it, please let me know of any bugs you encounter.

[size=4][b]Controls[/b][/size]
Create Bundle - With one stack on the cursor, Right Click another stack.
Add to Bundle - With either the bundle in the cursor or an item over the bundle, Right Click.
Empty a Bundle - With nothing in the cursor, Right Click a bundle.
Select One - Use the Up or Down keys, or use the Scroll Wheel to move the selection up or down. 
Take One - While hovering over a bundle with nothing in the cursor, Select One using the controls above and Middle Click to take one out.

All controls can be adjusted in the Config file.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Drop this into mods folder

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Install SMAPI first, but you already knew that.[/color]
